import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract target
y = train["target"].values

# Drop id and target from features
train_features = train.drop(["id", "target"], axis=1)
test_features = test.drop(["id"], axis=1)


# Feature engineering for string features (f_27)
def extract_string_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Length of string
    df["str_len"] = df["f_27"].str.len()
    # Count unique characters
    df["unique_chars"] = df["f_27"].apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))
    # Count specific character patterns
    for char in [
        "A",
        "B",
        "C",
        "D",
        "E",
        "F",
        "G",
        "H",
        "I",
        "J",
        "K",
        "L",
        "M",
        "N",
        "O",
        "P",
        "Q",
        "R",
    ]:
        df[f"count_{char}"] = df["f_27"].str.count(char)
    # First and last character
    df["first_char"] = df["f_27"].str[0]
    df["last_char"] = df["f_27"].str[-1]
    # Middle character
    df["mid_char"] = df["f_27"].str[4]  # 10-character string, middle is position 4 or 5
    return df


# Apply feature engineering
train_features = extract_string_features(train_features)
test_features = extract_string_features(test_features)

# Drop original string feature as we've extracted useful info
train_features = train_features.drop("f_27", axis=1)
test_features = test_features.drop("f_27", axis=1)

# Encode categorical features (f_29, f_30, first_char, last_char, mid_char)
categorical_cols = ["f_29", "f_30", "first_char", "last_char", "mid_char"]
label_encoders = {}
for col in categorical_cols:
    le = LabelEncoder()
    # Combine train and test for consistent encoding
    combined = pd.concat([train_features[col], test_features[col]], axis=0)
    le.fit(combined)
    train_features[col] = le.transform(train_features[col])
    test_features[col] = le.transform(test_features[col])
    label_encoders[col] = le

# Handle remaining numeric columns - create interaction features
numeric_cols = [col for col in train_features.columns if col not in categorical_cols]

# Create pairwise product features for top numeric features (sample for efficiency)
np.random.seed(42)
numeric_to_use = numeric_cols[:10]  # Use first 10 numeric features for interactions
for i in range(len(numeric_to_use)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(numeric_to_use)):
        col1, col2 = numeric_to_use[i], numeric_to_use[j]
        feat_name = f"{col1}_x_{col2}"
        train_features[feat_name] = train_features[col1] * train_features[col2]
        test_features[feat_name] = test_features[col1] * test_features[col2]

# Create validation set
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_features.values, y, test_size=0.15, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# LightGBM parameters
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

# Train model
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    valid_names=["train", "valid"],
    num_boost_round=1000,
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

# Predict on validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
X_test = test_features.values
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"].values, "target": y_test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
